text:
At closing, the gate team read your full message with care and recorded the concerns in the desk ledger for follow-up. You reported that your companion animal's crate was not handled as expected and that the service provided at the airport left you dissatisfied, particularly in relation to the return of your property and the care shown at handoff.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk regrets the distress this caused and accepts that a journey involving a companion animal requires careful coordination from booking through pickup. Our records show that the desk team reviewed the booking notes, the transfer instructions, and the service change entries to confirm where the handling process should have remained more closely aligned with your request. <<FACT F118>> We understand that a missed crate can disrupt travel plans and create added concern for both traveler and animal, and that is not consistent with the standard we aim to maintain.

Please be assured that this complaint has been added to the formal service record, and the matter will remain open until the operational team completes its review. If the crate is located or additional supporting details become available, submit them through the same channel used for your original report so the file may be updated without delay. The desk also recommends that travelers keep boarding tags, transfer receipts, and any station notes together when making a claim, as complete records help the service team confirm the path taken by each item.

Aurelia Skyways treats every companion animal journey as a shared responsibility, and we appreciate the opportunity to correct deficiencies when they are identified. The gate, baggage, and animal handling teams will be reminded to follow the documented procedure with greater attention to handoff checks and ledger entry accuracy.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
